answer: Agents tie each identity to a hand-woven willow reel, its patterns checked against a central atlas. Fakes must retrace the 0.3s spindle motion per identity, and since farms can’t batch the historical replay checks, each new head costs 0.3s of unparallelizable time. Copper tokens are spent to verify pearl-stitched threads, forcing attackers to spend tokens they can’t farm in bulk.
